description: Log something that happened on a HubSpot contact (and its deal): type note, call, email, meeting or task (default from channel: call, meeting and email become their own kinds, anything else a note), body, subject, channel (whatsapp, sms, email, call, meeting, instagram, messenger, telegram, other), direction inbound/outbound, occurredAt, durationMinutes (calls, meetings), dueAt (tasks), hubspotOwnerId. contact is the HubSpot contact id or email; dealId attaches it to a deal too. Free.
name: log_hubspot_activity
title: Log an activity in HubSpot
